Topic 3.6: Buying food 3.0 Foods

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Buying food 3.0 Foods. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name foods bought from the different places in the different places. community,
2. appreciate the different places for buying food in the community. different places using computing devices. outlets and display in class. Core-Competence to be developed Creativity and imagination, communication and collaboration; Digital literacy

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Buying food 3.0 Foods.
2. Explain Buying food 3.0 Foods to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Buying food 3.0 Foods.
4. Show that you can: name foods bought from the different places in the different places. community,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Buying food 3.0 Foods. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Buying food 3.0 Foods important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
